answer: Locks are logged in pearl, expire in wharf, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 198 aliases thus needs 52 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2889 identities would post 1365 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
